--- a/self_audit/automatic.py

@@ -675,9 +675,14 @@ def compute_complete_support_margins(
                     all_logits.append(bl)
                     all_labels.append(by)
                     all_val.append(by != 255)
-            cat_logits = torch.cat(all_logits, dim=0)
-            cat_labels = torch.cat(all_labels, dim=0)
-            cat_val = torch.cat(all_val, dim=0)
+            # Real patients have different native H/W. Pad only the metric
+            # tensors, excluding every padded voxel from the reduction.
+            max_h = max(x.shape[-2] for x in all_logits)
+            max_w = max(x.shape[-1] for x in all_logits)
+            pads = [(0, max_w-x.shape[-1], 0, max_h-x.shape[-2]) for x in all_logits]
+            cat_logits = torch.cat([F.pad(x, pad) for x, pad in zip(all_logits, pads)], dim=0)
+            cat_labels = torch.cat([F.pad(x, pad, value=255) for x, pad in zip(all_labels, pads)], dim=0)
+            cat_val = torch.cat([F.pad(x, pad, value=False) for x, pad in zip(all_val, pads)], dim=0)
             m, _ = compute_margins(cat_logits, cat_labels, valid_mask=cat_val)
         if was_train:
             model.train(True)

+def test_full_ema_support_margins_keep_heterogeneous_native_shapes():
+    from self_audit.automatic import compute_complete_support_margins
